notes:
Independent C6 round-2 review of the current files, not the drawing pass. Read BRIEF-17 in full, both panel briefs, cycle-6 FIXES and panel reviews, the NOTES drawing/reduction method, and the earlier E/C6 findings. Inspected all 107 C6 inventory PNGs at native size and nearest-neighbour 4×; inspected all 16 regions of the final city at 4×, full-height guildhall separately, and selected defects at 8×. Checked the comparison references, named final derivatives, whole-house, L/T/dead-end, civic-square, tall/short in both hands, unlike-roof, wall/stair/tower and actor/reveal proofs. Review-only composites are critic-r17C6-2-*.png; no city17 art or composer was edited.

Technical passes: all 107 C6 assets match their inventory dimensions and hashes, have alpha only 0/255 and zero RGB under transparent pixels. The facade modules retain identical connection paint on rows 0 and 47. All 32 slate/brown partner masks compared byte-for-byte with their corresponding base drawing match. There are no seasonal partners in this C6 inventory, so seasonal-ground/summer-silhouette testing is not applicable; colourways were not mistaken for seasons. Inspected ten relevant grounds in literal 3×3 repeats at native and 4×, and the new small props over approved summer grass, cobbles and packed working-yard ground. No additional ground seam, soft-alpha or dirty-transparency failure was found.

The saved 1920×1440 final equals a fresh in-memory c6_render. The 3840×2880 output is exact NN 2×, all three named crops are exact NN 3× of their registered source rectangles, the squint is the correct greyscale conversion, and the comparison embeds the current-town, R15 and C6 sources at 1×. None fails for resampling. The 40×30-cell coordinator requirement supersedes the older approximate 1200×900 showcase size.

Repetition passes: independently recomputed 42 five-house frontage windows by resolved image hashes, with zero failures; reran the broader architectural/crop audit (511 instances, 203 windows), with zero reported failures; reran the legacy E L-block, market and height layouts, with no repetition failure. The former north rear-cap and eight forced trade-shop repeats are fixed. Modular storey histogram: 1:7, 2:30, 3:15, 4:4, 5:1 (57 buildings). Including the existing ancillary building classification: 1:15, 2:31, 3:15, 4:4, 5:1 (66; 22.73% one-storey), so the overall <=25% threshold passes. The five misplaced one-storey shop fronts still fail the separate district-height rule. Roof tones among modular buildings: 29 terracotta, 18 slate, 10 brown; mixed roofs are retained. No street-frontage lawn was found.

FIXES dispositions: 1 FAIL (physical enclosures and misplaced low fronts); 2 substantive layout/route work is visible (96 px gate elbow, northwest jogs, tower-foot detours and stepped district fronts), retained subject to the property repairs; 3 FAIL in tall-stack assembly although the newly drawn complete-house pilots improve depth; 4 FAIL (receiver slits, window clipping and unlike-roof contacts); 5 addressed (broad guildhall at base720 and lower flanks); 6 partly addressed (supported east church porch and square-facing market arcade), FAIL for the churchyard enclosure; 7 addressed at the key shop thresholds/inn porch; 8 route and reveal proof present, retain the deliberate northwest court; 9 repaired curtain/tower joins pass; 10 FAIL for the six abutment-B variants; 11 structural receiver-aware shadows and joined wall-run shade improve the prior mats; 12 resolved repetition passes; 13 alternate side houses, tower tops and the southern 48 px stagger are visible; 14 full-scale signs, rims/brackets and named trade symbols are visible, including the scribe; 15 six stalls and market through-routes retained; 16 FAIL in gate assembly, while the redrawn landing/stair pieces pass individually; 17 packed working yards, attached stores and drain are present but enclosure is still incomplete; 18 shrine apron, pump and visible hard-edged forge smoke present; 19 distinct vendors and one inn unloading cart present; 20 FAIL acceptance because proofs visibly retain the listed defects. Saved draw-order/clearance proofs are not runtime collision or navigation tests.

Do not shrink signs, shorten gate towers, extend shadow ownership or count 144 px projected roofs as 144 px ground footprints to repair these findings.
